```plato
library Sampling
{
    //==
    // # Deformation bodies for sampled curves and surfaces
    //
    // The IDeformable2D/IDeformable3D obligations of the discretized parametrics in
    // `sampling.types.plato`. The samples ARE the geometry — between them the
    // types interpolate linearly — so carrying every sample point through the
    // mapping is the discretization of the pointwise deform, and the sample
    // parameters survive unchanged.

    // The IDeformable2D obligation: every sample point carried through the
    // mapping, parameters unchanged.
    Deform(self: SampledCurve2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): SampledCurve2D
        => (self.Parameters, self.Points.Map(mapping));
```
